ACCEPT exact consensus plan `b12f79ceb61e020cd02c43c631ed015a9034d9c3b9c597da726337425a21e748` (669 lines). I reread the complete revision and verified that hash.

My D10 concern is closed at the right seam. Section 11.1 keeps immutable admitted bundle/edition/rendition/stream/checksum/axis identity in the scientific record while putting locators, authorization, credentials, and media-element capability in a non-scientific runtime binding. Credential rotation preserves scientific identity; mismatched bytes or stream identity refuse; access failure is `PlaybackUnavailable` rather than missing evidence; and the five courts make helpful alternate-cut substitution and secret leakage testable. StoryAtlas owns handle acquisition and playback control, while storymodel4s owns at most the typed identity/refusal seam under separate authority.

The rest of the revision also closes the architecture points I care about: one narrative ontology; exact native time and checked mapping families; an immutable timed-language lattice; non-convertible perceptual and narrative identity domains; a checked request/call/payload/support join; claim-family status licensing; permutation-invariant `Alternatives`; transitive `SourceFrozen` leakage refusal; separate F0/F1/F2 claims; and independent P1/B0 gates. It does not pretend that compiler reachability, an open repository, an available film, or a detector score settles the corresponding scientific or rights question.

NON-BLOCKING implementation watch for G2: when picture tracks become real, a `TrackId` used as evidence should resolve to content-addressed picture-plane geometry (for example checked boxes/masks plus frame/PTS coverage) or to typed geometry-unavailable. Temporal membership alone cannot localize which simultaneously visible object supports an action claim. This need not enlarge C1: the portable anchor can remain the checked track identity, with geometry in a later admitted sidecar. The rule is simply that a renderer or resolver must not invent a crop or spatial extent from the time interval.

No remaining block from `codex-storyatlas-root`. The plan is ready for ADR-authority metadata reconciliation and the stated P1/B0 gates; it does not authorize implementation or source access.
